title: Masco Corporation Form 8-K — Departure of Directors or Certain Officers
summary: Masco Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the upcoming departure of Group President Jai Shah, effective July 3, 2026. The filing details a separation agreement dated April 16, 2026 that includes cash payments, prorated bonus awards, RSU vesting provisions, and LTIP participation. This is a standard corporate governance disclosure unrelated to market structure or macro economic catalysts.
key_points: Jai Shah, Masco Corporation Group President, Plumbing and Wellness, will conclude service on July 3, 2026
Separation agreement dated April 16, 2026 provides $1,206,000 cash payment
Shah entitled to prorated 2026 cash bonus based on individual target and company performance
Prorated RSU award and potential share award under 2024-2026 LTIP included in agreement
Cash payment equal to value of remaining unvested RSUs from March 5, 2025 retention agreement, based on March 6, 2027 closing price
Mr. Shah forfeited remaining unvested RSUs under the retention incentive agreement per the April 16, 2026 agreement
